title: Abstract Factory

act2.summary: a third family, wide-format, whose parts overlap in name with offset

solutions.title: One PressFactory interface, one concrete factory per family
solutions.tradeoff: A new family is one new class implementing PressFactory - the compiler refuses to build it until all three parts are provided. The price: three independent, easy-to-read switch functions became a table of factory objects, and a caller now needs to hold a factory reference in scope instead of just a family string.

reviewFocus: Does buildPress ever hold two different PressFactory instances in scope at once?
Would TypeScript refuse to compile a WideFormatPressFactory that forgot createFeeder?
Does assemblePress's mismatch check ever actually fire on the pattern route - and if it can't, why does it still exist?
Do createPlate/createInkSystem/createFeeder still exist as independently-callable functions on the pattern route, and if so, can they still be used to build a mismatched set?
